statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-40179 (GHSA-vffh-x6r8-xx99, GO-2026-5662): the Prometheus web UI inserted metric names and label values into chart tooltips and the metrics explorer without escaping, a stored cross-site scripting issue. It is fixed in Prometheus 3.5.2 and 3.11.2, Go module github.com/prometheus/prometheus 0.311.2-0.20260410083055-07c6232d159b: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/security/advisories/GHSA-vffh-x6r8-xx99, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5662, https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18506, fix commit https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/commit/07c6232d159bfb474a077788be184d87adcfac3c, which changes only TypeScript and JavaScript files of the web UI under web/ui/. We read every published metrics-server-dev package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as of 2026-11-27: 29 builds, 0.8.1-r0 to the current 0.9.1-r2, each for x86_64 and aarch64 (58 packages), each download checked against the size and control checksum in the package index. Each package installs one file, /usr/bin/metrics-server, a statically linked Go program (no ELF interpreter and no dynamic section) built with GOOS=linux and CGO_ENABLED=0, which, unlike metrics-server, also carries DWARF debug sections; both architectures record the same Go toolchain and module versions in every build. The github.com/prometheus/prometheus version in the Go build information, with no replace directive for that module, is: 0.8.1-r0 to 0.8.1-r12 with v0.304.2; 0.9.0-r0 to 0.9.0-r12 with v0.313.0; 0.9.1-r0 to 0.9.1-r2 with v0.314.0. We read the function names in each program's Go line table (pclntab) and searched each program's bytes, which also finds the names of inlined functions. In every build the only github.com/prometheus/prometheus packages with functions in the program are model/exemplar, model/histogram, model/labels, model/textparse, model/timestamp and prompb/io/prometheus/client, plus schema, util/convertnhcb and util/kahansum from 0.9.0 on: the Prometheus metric data model and its text and protobuf exposition-format parsers. No build contains a function from github.com/prometheus/prometheus/web or any of its subpackages, which serve the web UI, and the byte search finds no github.com/prometheus/prometheus/web name, so the web UI and its scripts are not in the program. As a check, the same reads find runtime.main and model/textparse functions in every program, and the byte search finds more than a thousand github.com/prometheus/prometheus names in each. The vulnerable code is not compiled into any published build of this package.

statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-40179 (GHSA-vffh-x6r8-xx99, GO-2026-5662): the Prometheus web UI inserted metric names and label values into chart tooltips and the metrics explorer without escaping, a stored cross-site scripting issue. The metrics-server-fips-dev packages for Alpine 3.23 are the FIPS variant of metrics-server-dev, built from the same metrics-server source, but they are published in the DHI security repository, which has not been read for this assessment, so no metrics-server-fips-dev build has been inspected for this advisory. Pending: which github.com/prometheus/prometheus version and packages each build links, to establish whether the vulnerable code is present, in every published metrics-server-fips-dev build for Alpine 3.23 (x86_64 and aarch64).
